title: Email extraction - near-identical addresses differing by TLD (hard)
prompt: Emails on file: r.chen@example.com (personal), r.chen@example.org (work, preferred for all business correspondence), r.chen@example.net (old, inactive). Which one should be used for business correspondence?

metadata.hard_reason: Three near-identical addresses differing only by TLD; requires correctly parsing the parenthetical qualifiers rather than pattern-matching on the local part.
